title: Weekday-conditioned number inclusion model versus global-frequency and exact-uniform subset baselines
hypothesis: The weekday of the target draw may carry incremental information about which numbers are selected, beyond the global historical inclusion frequencies.

forecast.weekday_definition: UTC weekday of ISO calendar date; dates are date-only and this avoids local timezone/DST ambiguity.
forecast.prior_only_rule: For target index t, use only archive rows i<t. Target draw is scored only after both model forecasts have been frozen in memory.
forecast.per_number_probability: p_t(n)=(200/8 + c_t(n))/(200 + N_t), where c_t(n) is the count of prior draws containing n and N_t is the number of eligible prior draws.
forecast.global_model: Use all prior draws for c_t(n), N_t.
forecast.weekday_model: Use only prior draws whose ISO weekday equals the target weekday for c_t(n), N_t.
forecast.fixed_cardinality_subset_probability: P(D|F)=product_{n in D} odds_t(n) / e_5(odds_t(1),...,odds_t(40)), odds=p/(1-p), where e_5 is the fifth elementary symmetric polynomial over all 40 weights.
forecast.hyperparameters: No tuning. Prior equivalent draw count fixed at 200 before execution. No feature selection or post-hoc subgroup tuning.

endpoints.primary: Blind OOS paired mean log-likelihood gain weekday model minus global model.
endpoints.secondary_inferential: Blind OOS mean log-likelihood gain weekday model minus exact uniform 5-of-40.
descriptive_only: Discovery and Validation mean log-likelihood gains
Top-5 and Top-20 mean hit counts
endpoints.direction: One-sided alternative: positive gain favors the first named model.

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across exactly the two preregistered Blind OOS inferential endpoints. No additional subgroup p-values.

integrity_checks: Archive header, date uniqueness, strict chronology, five distinct sorted integers in 1..40.
All forecast counts and probability weights are computed from rows strictly before the target.
Exact e5 dynamic-programming normalizer; compare against brute-force enumeration for a small synthetic weight vector.
Exhaustive 658008-subset normalization for representative global and weekday forecasts.
Future-mutation invariance at nine fixed cutoffs.
Deterministic replay at eight fixed cutoffs.
All probability and log-likelihood values finite; subset probabilities normalized.
Target dates and split counts reconcile exactly to 1921/641/641.
limitations: The historical blind OOS period has already been exposed to prior SONAR research and is not a virgin holdout.
Weekday is a calendar covariate, not evidence of a physical mechanism in the draw process.
The model predicts a distribution over complete 5-number subsets; it does not establish an improved single ticket or a winning probability.
A positive historical result would remain exploratory and require prospective frozen confirmation under Q60.
